name: M6.Cyclic.boundary_is_cycle
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (a b : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial) (h : M6.Cyclic.CycleRing N), M6.Cyclic.syndrome N a b (M6.Cyclic.boundary N a b h) = 0
guidance: Unfold, commutativity gives two identical terms; characteristic two gives zero. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
